title: Backtest Fold
description: One rolling-origin fold and the minimum identifiers required to reconstruct its lineage: Backtest Run -> Backtest Fold -> Training Feature Set -> Training Run -> Model Artifact -> Prediction Feature Snapshot(s) -> BACKTEST Prediction Run(s) (Architecture Baseline section 9). Result content (outcomes, metrics, baseline comparison) is intentionally out of scope for this identity/provenance-focused Phase 0 contract, consistent with the backtesting engine itself being out of scope for this task; a dedicated schema for result payloads can be added once that engine exists. Positional correspondence between prediction_cutoffs, prediction_feature_snapshot_ids, and prediction_run_ids (one triple per predicted fixture) is a domain-logic invariant, not enforced by this schema.

prediction_cutoffs.description: One cutoff per fixture predicted within this fold; a fold may predict multiple fixtures before the next retraining cutoff.

prediction_run_ids.description: BACKTEST-context Prediction Runs produced by this fold.
